glance: Saturday night will mark the 29th meeting between Notre Dame and Miami. The series stands at an 18-9-1 all-time advantage for Notre Dame.
It is the second meeting between Marcus Freeman and Mario Cristobal as head coaches. Both are in their fifth season at the helm of their respective programs.
Notre Dame is 9-1-0 against Miami at Notre Dame Stadium.
The Irish have won three straight agianst the Hurricanes at Notre Dame Stadium, starting with the 1988 meeting between Notre Dame and Miami, when the Irish won a classic 31-30.
The two sides have entered the contest both ranked in the Top 25 on ten previous occasions, as this year’s meeting will mark the 11th such instance.
The last meeting between the Irish and the Hurricanes came last season in 2025. No. 10 Miami took a 27-24 decision over No. 5 Notre Dame at Hard Rock Stadium.
